question:
The following pie chart gives the measures of the central angles of the sectors that reflect the number of beds in each of 7 different hospitals with respect to the total number of beds in these 7 hospitals taken together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0de2a3b93e3c1eb12b1757f234d0fc544bbb311f5858b76f45301a013903a65f.png] 

If the number of beds in H7 are 39, then what is the total number of beds in all the 7 hospitals taken together?
solution:
Calculation:

H7 represents 26° of the pie chart while the entire pie chart equals 360°.

Now, the total number of beds in all 7 hospitals taken together

⇒ frac {39}{26} times 360

⇒ 540

**∴ The total number of beds in all 7 hospitals taken together is 540.**
